title: Interface design based on strain isolation theory with an optimized neutral mechanical plane enables highly ductile and flexible organic photovoltaics
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,2318-2329
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE02963A, Paper
Shumin Zeng, Haojie Li, Siqi Liu, Tangyue Xue, Kai Zhang, Lin Hu, Zheren Cai, Yongting Cui, Hanlin Wang, Meng Zhang, Xiaotian Hu, Long Ye, Yanlin Song, Yiwang Chen
The neutral mechanical plane design can improve the mechanical properties of PEDOT:PSS film and FOSCs. A twistable organic photovoltaic module that is the first to be evaluated for mechanical stability and has a PCE of more than 14%.
